name: Patterns and textiles
description: Woven silks, printed cottons, embroideries, quilts, rugs, kimono and pattern designs from three centuries, chosen for their repeating patterns and colour on a tall screen.

works.alt_text: A length of red silk woven with a repeating pattern of stylised gold poppy seed heads in rows.
A woven wool fabric with a dense repeat of pale green tulips and leaves and small red roses on a dark blue-green ground.
A red silk kimono embroidered with a gnarled gold plum tree covered in small white blossoms, displayed flat against a pale grey backdrop.
A fragment of embroidered linen with a lattice of coral-pink diamonds framed by green, yellow and blue chevrons, crossed by interlaced bands of gold thread, its edges frayed.
A cream silk dress panel scattered with small woven bouquets of pink roses and yellow flowers in tiny baskets.
A golden yellow silk woven with blue, pink and green peonies, leaves and white cloud-like scrolls.
A white quilt with navy blue four-pointed stars and leaf shapes and a border of navy triangles, finely quilted between.
A pink silk fabric with a repeating pattern of large coral flowers on curling stems over a ground of small leaves.
A pale cotton panel printed in soft blue with a symmetrical ornamental design of scrolls, a central star and a border of leaves.
A pale green silk woven with trailing garlands of pink and red roses and feathery white sprays.
A large embroidered hanging of rows of round red blossoms on vines around a central star, on a golden ground.
An embroidered panel of a winding tree with large curling green leaves, flowers, birds and small animals on cream linen.
A crimson silk woven with vertical stripes of white flower sprays and green scalloped leaf bands.
A Noh theatre robe of silk brocade in bands of pale blue, cream and gold, patterned with blue and lilac flowers and grasses.
A pink silk panel woven with a large symmetrical design of silver-green leaves, fruit and flowers, with a small hole in its lower half.
A printed linen and cotton with a repeating pattern of red and pink flower heads and green leaves on a soft brown ground.
A fragment of magenta silk woven with close rows of small cream and pale blue flowering plants, its edges frayed.
A woven silk with a symmetrical repeat of grey-green pagodas, vases and flowers on a warm brown ground.
A woven silk fragment with large pink peonies, green leaves and small blue flowers around tiny landscape scenes.
A golden silk panel woven with small coloured flowers, leafy scrolls and pink lattice bands.
A fragment of gold-brocaded silk velvet with a large pine-cone motif among curling leaves and flowers, outlined in crimson.
A grey-green silk woven with trailing brown oak leaves and round pink and gold flower heads among white waves.
A cream silk dress panel woven with scattered sprays of small red, pink and blue flowers and faint white leaves.
A printed design of feathery ferns and fanciful flowers in orange, pink, green and lilac on pale paper.
